scripts.prepare-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','app.js','style.css','chart.js','manifest.json','attendance_template.xlsx','TBTA-2026-2027- RHS-Student_Attendance.xlsx','TBTA-2026- 27- Riverview High School-Students  list.xlsx'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/'+f);});"
scripts.sync: npm run prepare-assets && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const jdkPath=path.join(process.env.USERPROFILE,'.jdks','jdk-21.0.6+7'); const env={...process.env,JAVA_HOME:jdkPath,ANDROID_HOME:path.join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA,'Android','Sdk')}; execSync('gradlew.bat assembleDebug',{cwd:'android',env,stdio:'inherit'}); fs.mkdirSync('apk',{recursive:true}); const src='android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'; if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,'apk/TBTA-Attendance-Tracker.apk'); fs.copyFileSync(src,'apk/app-debug.apk'); console.log('APK built and saved to apk/ directory');}"
